Hundreds of volunteers and police searched the area, focusing on challenging terrain and dense vegetation. Eventually, a helicopter spotted his fishing tackle box, leading to his rescue beside a creek.

title: In 1972, flight attendant survived 10,160m fall after bomb tore plane apart
description: On January 26, 1972, a tragic incident involved a Yugoslav Airlines flight which broke apart in midair above Czechoslovakia. Flight attendant Vesna Vulovic experienced an extraordinary survival, enduring a fall from over 10,000 meters while trapped inside the wreckage. Although she faced serious injuries, her remarkable recovery led to her being featured in Guinness World Records.

title: Feral pigs cause $3.4bn damage yearly in US; $51.9m pledged for removal
description: Feral pigs are wreaking havoc on U.S. agriculture and ecosystems, prompting the USDA to allocate $51.9 million for targeted removal initiatives. This funding will support landowners across 13 states, enhancing trapping efforts and ecosystem restoration. Coordinated projects aim to control the surging feral swine population, ultimately reducing economic losses and protecting public health in the face of this invasive threat.

title: CEO Jensen Huang exits amid spy row; Nvidia hails his 'immeasurable contribution'
5 people shot in neighbourhood near White House; area cordoned off

Authorities cordoned off businesses, a church, and residential buildings during their investigation of the shooting. The police were searching for a suspect and described the situation as an active shooter event. Emergency teams established multiple road closures and urged the public to avoid the vicinity.

title: Mississippi landlord's $99,468 rent suit against youth sports group revived
description: A Mississippi appeals court has revived a landlord's $99,468 lawsuit against a couple over alleged unpaid rent and unfinished repairs. It ruled that the lower court wrongly dismissed the complaint without a request from the couple for summary judgment in their favour. The court has not decided whether they owe the money.

India's Ambekar Meetei scripts history with boxing gold at Dakar Youth Olympics
description: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei made history at Dakar 2026 by clinching the gold medal in the men's 50kg boxing category, edging out Ireland’s Kristian Jubani in a nail-biting 3-2 final. His path to glory included a resounding 5-0 victory over Colombia's Izzon Jeffrey Galea Arevalo. This achievement signifies a significant moment for Indian sports, breaking a 16-year streak without an Indian boxer in the finals of the Youth Olympic Games.

title: 'They lied about my mother for years': Priyanka Gandhi hits back at BJP over Sonia's memoir
Alice Huang barred from entering country, misled probe into Megaspeed: Singapore
description: Alice Huang, a Chinese entrepreneur, faces a warning and a ban from returning to Singapore as investigations unfold. Authorities are scrutinizing her for allegedly providing deceptive information related to Megaspeed, a data center firm. Although evidence against her is lacking, probes continue into multiple individuals. Notably, her ties to Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, have sparked significant public interest and raised alarms regarding her business ventures.

title: Abu Dhabi Police arrest 10 after Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili hotel brawl
description: A mass brawl involving Usman Nurmagomedov and former UFC champion Merab Dvalishvili erupted at an Abu Dhabi hotel ahead of Saturday's RAF event. Abu Dhabi Police confirmed 10 arrests, while footage of the confrontation and claims from both camps have fuelled attention around the incident. The clash also reignites a rivalry involving Umar Nurmagomedov dating back to UFC 311.

title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp, who gave $2M to Republicans, now says he is a Democrat
description: Palantir CEO Alex Karp told Politico he has been a Democrat his whole life and called Palantir’s products “essentially progressive,” a week after Democrats swept the US midterms. Karp’s company helps power ICE deportations, and he put roughly $2 million into largely Republican causes, including MAGA Inc. and Trump’s inauguration. He says his giving is balanced. Karp is open to backing a Democrat in 2028 as Congress readies tech probes.

title: Google, Microsoft & more: Valuation of firms led by Indian CEOs hits $15 trillion
description: A wave of Indian-origin business leaders is reshaping the global corporate landscape, amassing an impressive collective valuation of $15 trillion. The rise of artificial intelligence has been instrumental in this growth, with 103 out of the 200 companies listed in the HSBC Hurun Global Indians List 2026 leveraging AI technology.

title: 'Shouting match from hell': Trump, Netanyahu clash in explosive phone call over Iran war
description: US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently faced challenges regarding Iran's nuclear strategy. Trump prefers diplomatic solutions while Netanyahu advocates for military action and regime change in Tehran. Their disagreement highlights political tensions as Netanyahu's leadership faces increasing opposition at home. In Israel, opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot is working to form a coalition government.

title: Sandpaper-gate takes fresh twist as former coach accused of hiding the truth.
description: Recent revelations have resurfaced surrounding the infamous 2018 Australian ball-tampering scandal, implicating David Saker, the former bowling coach. Allegedly, Saker counseled players Steve Smith and Cameron Bancroft to hide the use of sandpaper. Usman Khawaja's memoir reveals that the conspiracy involved the broader team, as Saker reportedly pushed for innovative approaches to achieve reverse swing, with insightful exchanges providing a glimpse into the team's mentality at the time.

title: Brittany Mahomes opens up about expanding community efforts in Kansas City
description: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ top quarterback, and his wife, Brittany Mahomes, expand their efforts in kansas City as she opens up about it.

title: Vivaan Kapoor wins silver at ISSF World Championship, secures LA Olympics quota
description: Vivaan Kapoor proudly clinched a silver medal in the men's trap event at the ISSF World Championships, following a nail-biting shoot-off where he just fell short against Abdulrahman Alfaihan of Kuwait. His remarkable achievement not only signifies personal success but also grants him a coveted quota place for the upcoming 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, reflecting the increasing stature of Indian shooters on the global stage.

title: Sonam Wangchuk faces restrictions on movement in Leh amid opposition to polls
ED secures 4-day custody of Azam Khan in money laundering case
description: Senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan has been granted four days' custody by the Enforcement Directorate. This is in connection with a money laundering investigation related to the Mohammad Ali Jauhar University. The court found the need for custodial interrogation due to the complexity of the financial irregularities associated with the university project. Khan has been accused of evading previous questioning and facing multiple age-related health issues.

title: Watch: Families of 1984 anti-Sikh riots victims burn Sonia Gandhi's memoir
Everyone wanted a Labubu. What happened?

Recent sales data reveals a dramatic fall in global revenue, resulting in collectors becoming increasingly discerning. As enthusiasts pivot towards new toy brands and characters, many are reevaluating their investments in Labubu dolls, signaling a pivotal shift in the collecting landscape.

India's chase was magnificent as they reached 230 runs with only 2 wickets down, outpacing Afghanistan's score of 228 runs and finishing the game in 36.5 overs. Captain Lakshya Raichandani delivered a stellar performance with 93 runs.

With Chirag Paswan also eyeing an expansion in UP, the 2027 assembly contest could see multiple players competing for overlapping caste constituencies.

title: Road to parenthood: What every couple should know before choosing IVF
description: IVF, or in vitro fertilisation, is a well-recognized method of assisted reproduction for couples struggling with infertility. This intricate procedure consists of different steps, including ovarian stimulation and the eventual transfer of embryos. Many couples face diverse fertility hurdles that lead them to explore IVF. Throughout this journey, fostering emotional support and maintaining realistic expectations is essential, alongside understanding the financial costs and legal considerations surrounding IVF in India.

title: 'Not random': Zelenskyy flags 'systematic disruptions' in Musk's Starshield
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed serious worries about interruptions to the Starshield satellite communication system. He pointed out that speed limitations are obstructing military operations aimed at intercepting Russian drones that are escalating attacks. These issues seem to be systematic rather than just technical glitches. While earlier restrictions were noted in October, the Ukrainian defense ministry has recently reported a resumption of services.

title: Pakistan's Saqib Khan wreaks havoc against Sri Lanka, enters record books
description: Saqib Khan made a notable impact during his Test debut by taking seven wickets against Sri Lanka. He dismissed key players, including Captain Kusal Mendis and Dhananjaya de Silva, to help Pakistan regain control. With a slender first-innings lead of 12 runs, Sri Lanka was bowled out for 446. Pakistan's second innings saw them at 57 for one before rain halted play.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave away $7 billion in 2025, over one-third of US major gifts
Is AI putting Indian IT jobs at risk? What Moody’s says about the future of work
description: The rise of AI is stirring concerns in India's IT and BPO industries about productivity and job security. Moody's Ratings highlights the uncertainty regarding AI's potential employment impact, as concrete evidence remains elusive. India struggles with its digital infrastructure and skilled labor needed to harness AI effectively. However, if geopolitical tensions in the Middle East diminish, India's economic growth prospects could enhance.

title: India's new defence battle: Rooting out Chinese tech from its weapons
description: India is focusing on the security of military equipment by investigating component origins and assembly processes. The government has implemented restrictions on importing components from adversarial countries like China since 2020. Additionally, new frameworks for assessing security vulnerabilities in drones are being established through Army Design Bureau initiatives. The AASHVAST laboratories will conduct thorough checks of drone hardware and software for potential risks.

title: AI, talent gaps and labour reforms: Forces redefining India's employment landscape
description: India's employment landscape is undergoing a fundamental shift. The opportunity lies in ensuring that employees are equipped to work effectively with these tools. As AI adoption deepens, organisations will need to focus not just on technology deployment but also on helping their workforce understand, adopt and use these capabilities responsibly.

title: Retail inflation soars to 2-year high of 6.09%, crosses RBI’s upper limit
description: Inflation was higher in rural areas at 6.63%, while the urban rate was 5.41%. Food inflation, calculated using the All India Consumer Food Price Index (CFPI), reached a provisional 8.94% in October 2026 from a year earlier. The corresponding rates were 9.09% in rural areas and 8.68% in urban areas.

title: Michael Carrick sacked as Manchester United head coach as turmoil deepens
description: The 45-year-old's departure comes after several days of uncertainty over his future, with United already working on appointing Mauricio Pochettino as his replacement.

title: Netanyahu's Iran gamble: Can caretaker Israeli PM launch a war?
Kusal Mendis scripts history, joins Kohli, Smith and Root in elite club
description: In a remarkable feat, Kusal Mendis has etched his name in cricket history as the first Sri Lankan to score a century on debut as Test captain, amassing an impressive 117 not out. His stellar performance came at a crucial moment, aiding Sri Lanka in recovering from a challenging position.

title: Sam Pitroda praises PM Modi, receives Diwali wishes; X user's cheeky request gets a reply
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended Diwali and Gujarati New Year greetings to Congress leader Sam Pitroda after the latter spoke warmly about their personal equation. The exchange took an amusing turn when an X user asked for festive wishes too, prompting a response from the Prime Minister.

title: Bihar gangrape survivor thrown off roof; family alleges threats to drop case
description: In Begusarai, a 28-year-old woman faced a new attack closely following a gang rape incident. She was thrown from her house roof, reportedly by criminals pressing her family to withdraw the rape case. This incident occurred four months after the brutal gang rape that left her injured and in fear. Despite the arrest of several suspects, threats from the main accused continued against her family.

title: Delhi woman selling flowers attacked with sticks by multiple men on camera
description: A woman selling flowers on a roadside in Hauz Khas was assaulted by multiple men with sticks. Video footage of the incident is currently circulating on social media platforms, showcasing the violent altercation. According to social media claims, the men had allegedly asked her to sell drugs, which she refused. Local police acknowledged they had not received a formal complaint but are currently investigating the incident.

title: Video: Rivals ram SUV, chase history-sheeter, hack him to death with axe in Jaipur
description: Vijay Bajiya, a history-sheeter, was attacked and killed in Jaipur's Kardhani area on Wednesday night. A group of four to six men rammed their vehicle into Bajiya's SUV, forcing it to stop. As Bajiya attempted to escape, he was surrounded and fatally attacked with axes and sticks. The assailants fled the scene after the attack, which lasted about five minutes.

title: Delhi's traffic curbs in vain? Report suggests they may have made little difference
description: Delhi’s air pollution levels have increased this year compared to 2025, with stubble smoke adding to the problem. Emergency traffic measures put in place have not reduced congestion significantly, impacting daily travel times. Traffic analysis indicates that local vehicular emissions play a major role in air quality issues. NO2 levels have surged recently during evening traffic hours, remaining high despite road traffic decreasing.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ three children: Meet Sterling, Bronze and Golden
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are excitedly awaiting the arrival of their fourth child, expanding their family further. The couple, who share three previous children, skillfully balances parenting with Patrick's demanding NFL career. Their love story blossomed in 2021, culminating in their marriage in 2022 and the joyous births of their children, each cherishing unique bonds with Patrick's football journey.
